verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers a CLI for running tests/monitoring/collection management and an MCP server that lets an agent read and modify collections, requests, environments, and teams and send real HTTP requests, giving substantial programmatic parity with core UI actions. However, there is no documented general-purpose REST/GraphQL API (probe found no OpenAPI/swagger spec), and features like team collaboration, SSO/admin settings, or UI-specific extras (themes, PWA, client certs) aren't shown as scriptable. Missing for 10: a documented public API covering full UI feature parity, evidence for automating admin/enterprise/team-collab features, and independent confirmation of CLI/MCP completeness.
